reasoning.step2:
GrandTotal.Amount — Confidence: High (≈95%)
- Evidence: Multiple occurrences "NET A PAYER 480,00", "Total : 480,00", and invoice summary showing 480,00. Clear numeric total in invoice footer. Minimal ambiguity.

Invoice.Date — Confidence: High (≈90%)
- Evidence: Appears as "31/12/22" on page 1 and as "31/12/2022" on page 2 (header "Date 31/12/2022"). Full four-digit year present. Minor potential OCR ambiguity between 31/12/22 and 31/12/2022 but full form exists.

Sender.VatId — Confidence: Medium-High (≈80%)
- Evidence: Text shows "N° Intracom FR 09434891545" and elsewhere "N° TVA FR 09 434 891 545". These match and indicate supplier VAT number. OCR spacing could produce variants, but the intracom FR number is explicit. Possible ambiguity whether other FR number (FR47546650334) belongs to recipient (Dachser) — selection of FR09434891545 as sender is supported by sender block.

Vat.Rate — Confidence: High (≈90%)
- Evidence: Tax table shows "Taux 20,00" corresponding to VAT group. Clear single VAT rate applied. OCR unlikely to misread 20,00 here.

Net.Amount — Confidence: High (≈92%)
- Evidence: Totals show "Base H.T." / Totaux H.T. 400,00 consistent with VAT 20% yielding VAT 80 and total 480. Clear mapping.

Vat.Amount — Confidence: High (≈92%)
- Evidence: Tax table lists "Montant TVA 80,00" and totals present 80,00. Consistent arithmetically with net 400 and total 480.

Overall consistency: Net + VAT = Grand Total (400,00 + 80,00 = 480,00) and VAT rate 20% consistent with VAT amount (20% of 400 = 80), supporting high confidence in numeric fields.
